shots.visual_description: Animated infographic showing common signs of protein deficiency (e.g., 'Fatigue', 'Slow Recovery') with a slightly concerned facial expression icon. Muted color palette transitions to a question mark. Gentle zoom in.

shots.visual_description: Smooth transition to the protein powder product, highlighting its 'High Protein' and 'Pure Ingredients' claims on the label. Product sits on a clean, minimalist background with soft, trustworthy lighting. Dolly in on product.
shots.narration: 别担心！我们的优质蛋白粉，为你提供每日所需的全面营养支持。

shots.visual_description: Macro shot of the fine protein powder texture, followed by an overlay graphic detailing key ingredients and a balanced amino acid profile. Professional, scientific, and clean visual style. Pan across ingredients list.
shots.narration: 精选高纯度乳清蛋白，易消化易吸收，科学配方助你高效补充。

shots.visual_description: A person (dressed in lab coat or smart casual, exuding expertise) preparing a protein shake, explaining its benefits concisely to the camera. Well-lit, professional studio setting. Medium shot.
shots.narration: 无论是增肌、减脂还是日常保健，它都是你理想的健康伙伴。

shots.visual_description: Product packaging displayed prominently with a call to action. Overlay text: '专家推荐', '品质保证'. Confident, direct camera angle. A hand reaches in to tap a 'Shop Now' button.
shots.narration: 投资健康，从优质蛋白开始！点击链接，了解更多科学补给方案！

key_findings: 用户追求高效便捷的营养补充方式
